rh.number_traceability.outcome_column_cl.reason: The vacuum Outcome cell compares an alleged 10.62% resolution drift before repair with 0.15% afterward, although those numbers use different definitions. rh.number_traceability.figures_regenerab.reason: Figure 3(d) labels and describes its frequency normalization as 2m*, but the plotting code divides by the finite-wavenumber pair prediction. The small lattice correction to m* cannot explain this difference. Missing spectrum archives limit further reconstruction but are not the basis of this finding.
